title: A Carolina Venus flytrap
done: You made a Venus flytrap! It grows wild only near Wilmington, North Carolina, and a bit of South Carolina.

steps.say: Put a red square flat on the table. It is the inside of the trap.
Put a green square on the left. One side of the trap.
Put a green square on the right. The other side.
Put a green triangle on top, at the left. A pointy tooth!
Put a green triangle on top, in the middle.
Put a green triangle on top, at the right.
Put a green triangle under the left side. More teeth!
Put a green triangle under the middle.
Put a green triangle under the right side. Snap!
